runtime_gates: the receiver is an opaque vtable holder and the target never dereferences it; the two holder arguments are equally opaque
all five ports are dependency-only, so the two dispatch paths are unverified in this package
the seven probe code constants are undecoded
the word read at probe + 4 is opaque and its runtime meaning is undecoded
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation compares the probe result with zero as a full word; the assembly tests the low byte with TEST AL,0xff, so the model narrows to the byte
the fourth stack argument is never read; the model keeps it declared and unreferenced rather than inventing a use
the primary path reports through 0x006ac0a0 before it returns, and the decompilation dropped that call; the corrected model keeps the report inside the primary branch
